info.title: AI Employee Workforce Kit API
info.description:
Tasks, runs, approvals and the Brain Inspector. The web app uses this same API.

Errors are `{"error": {code, message, retryable}}`; when `retryable` is true, wait for `Retry-After` and send the same request (with the same `Idempotency-Key`) again.

Authentication: production puts OIDC (Keycloak) in front. Locally (`WFK_AUTH_MODE=dev`) every request acts as the dev tenant; `X-WFK-Actor` names the person, and `WFK_API_TOKEN` adds a bearer token check.
